turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, am I speaking with the account holder? This is Marcus Ellery from the fraud prevention team at Northbridge Savings. I'm showing three attempted transfers in the last twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Who is this again? What team?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Marcus Ellery, fraud prevention. I can stop the third transfer but it clears in about four minutes and I can only hold it while we're on the line.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then it clears. I'm not making decisions on a four minute clock.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. Our systems flagged this automatically, case reference 8841-C. Are you somewhere you can talk freely?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A case number doesn't tell me anything. Anyone can say a number down a phone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's fair. To pull up the right record I just need the last four digits of the account.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No. You called me. I'm not confirming anything about my account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Without that I can't stop the transfer. You can reach me directly on 555-0142 if we get cut off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm not calling a number you gave me. I'm hanging up and calling the number on the back of my card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You'll lose the window if you do that.
